demos.name: A2A Lab
demos.description: A generalist agent hands off to a specialist: two RFC 8693 exchanges build the nested act chain act={specialist, act:{generalist}}, scope narrowed per hop. The gateway routes the call only when the SPECIALIST is registered — same user, same shape, unregistered identity denied (UC2.6 PERMIT_THEN_DENY). Agent Card served; no bearer is a real 401 (UC2.7). Mock of UC2/UC2.5/UC2.6/UC2.7.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7700). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7700 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). The decision contract mirrors the AI-DEMO2 a2aDelegationService chained RFC 8693 exchange (scope narrowed per hop) + GatewayTokenPolicy nested-act exemption + the Agent Card registry (UC2.6 WHO-is-acting), enforced live 2026-11-06. Repo: curtismu7/a2a-lab-LAB. Catalog id D121 (assigned 2026-11-07).
